## Result

- Skill: delivery-review.
- Review status: approved.
- Review ID: delivery-review-r4.
- Package member: one unchanged exact primary plan.
- Current upstream Design: design-review-r7, five exact subjects.
- Material findings / plan correction / work initialization: none.
- Next owner: Route for required fresh whole-change Code Review then distinct Verify.
- Claim limits: allocation/applicability judgment only; no implementation completion, Verify or external handoff claim.

## Bounded reassessment of the whole plan

The primary plan's exact SHA-256 is unchanged from delivery-review-r3. I retained the complete sequencing/proof assessment and checked the effect of the new scoped consumer correction against it. The correction changes only RC descriptions of current versus historical authority and its convention references. All assessment requirements/decisions and the existing RF/CLI runtime behavior remain unchanged. It requires no new implementation milestone, test mechanism, installer change, release operation or reallocation of the approved behavioral proof.

The plan already allocates current owner/consumer reconciliation, preserved historical meaning and actual affected-document checks, and requires owning-stage reassessment after a relevant subject changes. Its rule for newly identified directly required consumers permits this same-responsibility clarification under the separately supplied user authority; this is not deferred present work, a new model consolidation, or a silent change to its milestone boundary. RC remains an unchanged policy dependency in the semantic sense; its revised exact file is nevertheless included in current Design assessment and requires fresh final review/Verify applicability. No author approval or filename-only exemption is used.

M1/M2 runtime/resource behavior and their local/integrated proof allocation remain adequate. The completed work entries are not reinitialized, and the plan's required final whole-change Code Review followed by distinct Verify remains the route for this correction. Previously recorded final approval/Verify is not assumed current merely because executable code stayed unchanged. New doc checks and current subject assessment are appropriate; existing execution proof needs the responsible assessor's affirmative unaffected rationale rather than invented reruns. Prior Delivery r3 remains attached to its original basis; r4 binds this unchanged plan to r7's current package without rewriting planning history.

## Correction basis

The explicit user refinement is a bounded current-authority clarification, not a return to runtime compatibility design. Record Format RF-SR-06 already retires all v1 runtime acceptance, and CLI-SR-10/18 plus its current/retired discovery and transport clauses already implement that selected contract. Those models require no changes. The retained explicit-recording-v1 model-validation marker and targeted-recording-v1 transport name version independent surfaces; their spelling never selects stored v1.

The actual RC diff removes the contrary current weaker-v1-reader/rollback statements and references those existing owners. Earlier v1 bytes, vocabulary, approval subjects and procedural context remain archival without conversion or fabricated origin. The extraction maps retain source identities and decision meaning; introductory/drafting/follow-on descriptions distinguish historical scope from current adoption and activity. Model conventions/mapping now reference Design while Workflow retains coordination. No new RC policy, gate, schema, runtime reader or permission is introduced, and installation remains separate from customer adoption.

Independent Python extraction compared all18 RC-SR rows and all5 RC-DEC rows against d62fd3fa: each is byte-identical. Marker spelling is unchanged. The compatibility scenario is clarified consistently with RF-SR-06, without adding an installer/runtime behavior or weakening historical preservation. Actual diff and link targets support source ownership coherence; author boundary/prose/readability and link checks are inspection evidence, not approval. The45 length warnings are reported, not converted into semantic findings. Existing13 historical installer prose errors retain their previous scoped limitation and are unrelated to this correction.

## Independence

Concrete independent nonauthor reviewer /root/independent_design_review. Primary-agent authored the scoped RC clarification following the explicit user request. Reviewer edited no governed Design/plan/package contribution and independently assessed current contracts, actual diff, preserved requirements/decisions and five exact subjects.
